title: The False Stag
summary: A stag approached a sheep and asked to borrow a bushel of wheat, naming the wolf as his guarantor and bondsman....
full_text:
On the outskirts of a quiet Hellenic village where shepherds tended their flocks upon the hills, A stag approached a sheep and asked to borrow a bushel of wheat, naming the wolf as his guarantor and bondsman..... The creatures of the field went about their daily lives according to their nature, each seeking their own advantage while keeping a vigilant watch over friends and foes alike.

As the hours passed, an unexpected turning point arose that tested their wits and character. A tense confrontation soon arose as rival desires crossed paths under the midday sun. Words were exchanged with cautious cunning, glances were measured, and each party sought to disguise their true intentions behind a veil of outward innocence.

Yet the timeless laws of nature cannot be deceived by clever words or false appearances. Natural instincts and sharp wits collided, bringing the trial to an immediate, decisive climax.  The outcome was swift and irreversible, leaving behind a lasting lesson for all who witnessed the event, proving that never lend to an untrustworthy borrower who has swift feet to flee when debts fall due.
moral: Never lend to an untrustworthy borrower who has swift feet to flee when debts fall due.
